sentences.text:
G. Manjula vs The State Of Telangana, on 4 September, 2025
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.16050 of 2024
Order:

entities.text: G. Manjula vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 5.
With their consent this writ petition is taken up for disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. The petitioner is aggrieved by the action of the respondent Nos.1 to 5 in not releasing the compensation amount to the respondent Nos.6 to 11 petitioners for the land bearing Plot No.11 in Sy.No.43 admeasuring 267 square yards or 223.31 square meters situated at Ward No.9, Block No.10, Roshandowla village, Saroornagar Revenue Mandal, Ranga Reddy District and Plot No.10 admeasuring 267 square yards or 223.23 square meters in Sy.No.43 situated at Ward No.9 Block No.10 Roshandowla village, Saroornagar Revenue Mandal, Ranga Reddy District respectively (hereinafter referred as 'subject property'), which was acquired by the respondents for 150 Feet Road as illegal, unlawful, unconstitutional and against the principles of natural justice and seeking a consequential direction to respondents to release the compensation amount to the petitioners for the subject property.

3. Brief facts stated in this writ petition are that the petitioner claims to the owner and possessor of the plot No.11 in the subject property which was acquired by way of registered sale deed dated 22.08.1998 vide document No.4332/1998.
Similarly, petitioner No.2 claims to be the owner and possessor of plot No.10 in the subject property which was acquired by way of registered sale deed dated 07.08.2000 vide document No.6137/2000.

It is further submitted that the Government of Andhra Pradesh has acquired the entire plot No.10 admeasuring 267 square and plot No.11 admeasuring 267 squares for widening of RCI road vide proceedings No.D/189/94 and passed the award on 31.10.2006 and at the time of passing the award, the land acquisition officer had neither issued any notices to the petitioners nor informed the said acquisition proceedings and till today there are no notices showing the delivery of the said property from the petitioners.

It is further submitted that when the petitioners have tried to construct the compound wall on 20.07.2018, the officials of the defence authorities came and objected their construction in and over the said property and informed that the petitioner's plots were acquired by the government for expansion of existing RCI Road through the said proceedings.
It is further submitted that the officials have also informed that the award was deposited into the account of LAOP No.44 of 2011 by showing that the amount was not claimed in the said property.

It is further submitted that the petitioner's plots shown as not claimed by any claimant as per the report sent by them in L.A.O.P.No.44 of 2011 and the acquisition officials have not issued any notices to the petitioners, as such the petitioners are unable to claim the award amount and also to participate in the award enquiry.

The petitioners further submits that they are entitled to receive the compensation which is awarded by the land acquisition officer in respect of part of plot Nos.10 and 11 admeasuring 267 square yards each.

It is further submitted that the respondents shown the petitioner's plots in the said acquisition G. Manjula vs The State Of Telangana, on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166959361/
1 proceedings and also awarded an amount of Rs.67,143/- each for plot Nos.10 and 11 in LAOP No.44 of 2011 under Sections 30 and 31 of L.A.Act and submits that no claim is filed by the petitioners.

entities.text: G. Manjula vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the petitioners herein filed a petition for impleading them in the above said LAOP in the year 2019 vide I.A.No.1068 of 2019 along with copy of GPA and Rule 32 Petition vide I.A.No.1069 of 2019 but, at the time of filing the said petition, the petitioners could not file the affidavit under Rule 33 of C.R.P due to oversight and on the basis of the same, the petition was dismissed on 05.01.2024.

It is further submitted that petitioners recently came to know that the respondents are taking steps for releasing the compensation amount to unofficial respondent Nos.5 to 10, the petitioners approached the respondents several times stating that they are entitled to claim the compensation and the respondents are refusing to release the compensation.
Questioning the same, the present writ petition is filed.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition has placed the instructions submitted by the Special Deputy Collector (LA), I.A.P.Shamshabad, Rangareddy District wherein it is submitted that an extent of 267+223.21 square yards of land pertains to Sy.No.43 of Roshanuddowla village of Saroornagar Mandal, Ranga Reddy District was acquired for the purpose of widening of 150 wide road and the compensation sanction amount of the land is not released and paid till date.

It is further submitted that a total of 2539.00 square yards of land falling in Sy.No.43 of the said village was acquired and award passed vide proceedings No.D/189/1994 dated 31.10.2006 but, the payment of compensation was not made due to the existence of dispute between the parties and pending clearance of Urban Land Ceiling and non-claims over the plots.

It is further submitted that entire compensation amount of the acquired area was referred under Section 30 of the LA Act to the Hon'ble Prl. District Judge, Ranga Reddy District for the decision of the Court and since the case was already referred to the Hon'ble Court, so this office do not have any role to take a decision on payment of compensation and requested to direct the petitioner to approach the Hon'ble Court.

entities.text: Prl. District Judge, Ranga Reddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. After arguing at length, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that they would take appropriate steps in representing the case in L.A.O.P.No.44 of 2011 and pray this Court to pass appropriate orders.

6. Recording the same, the petitioners are granted liberty to pursue the L.A.O.P.No.44 of 2011,
pending on the file of IV Additional Senior Civil Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar.

entities.text: Additional Senior Civil Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
No order as to costs.

JUSTICE N.V.SHRAVAN KUMAR Date:04.09.2025 VRKS G. Manjula vs The State Of Telangana, on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166959361/
